notes.title: About large-scale updates
notes.content:
Hello, I'm YGAMES.

First of all, I would like to sincerely thank the users who bought my game after watching my game.

In developing a single person, it was not enough for the individual to handle the game, such as funding problems/tax problems.

So, I'm saving money from part-time jobs and outsourcing,
From now on, we are going to update the interaction and what to enjoy every two weeks.

- Monster in the Cave
- Adding interaction in the cave
- a house collection
- Collection Utilization
- a fighting system
- Animals and Hunting
- Architecture

And more and more will be added gradually.

YGAMES will actively reflect the opinions of users
We'll always try our best.

Thank you always
